title: Capture preparation motivation
epic: Epic 1 Candidate onboarding and interview plan
criteria: Collect target company, role and seniority, motivation, biggest difficulty, interview date if known, and available preparation time. Allow unknown dates and optional context.
Show a concise profile for confirmation; changes persist across conversations. Do not require sensitive career or employment details beyond what the user chooses to share.

title: Ground behavioral preparation in a resume
epic: Epic 1 Candidate onboarding and interview plan
criteria: Prompt for a resume before personalized behavioral preparation. If it is missing, allow general practice and label it as unpersonalized.
Extract and confirm relevant roles, projects and achievements; ask for missing details. Never invent accomplishments, numbers or ownership.
Store resume files with ownership metadata and allow the candidate to replace or remove them.

title: Create a company specific round plan
epic: Epic 1 Candidate onboarding and interview plan
criteria: Use recruiter supplied round information first, current official company guidance next, and the reference bank for question patterns. Label assumptions and source dates.
Allow candidates to confirm or edit round names and emphasis. Do not force a universal FAANG loop or assume all roles use the same rounds.
For role changes, preserve history and create a new plan without silently mixing readiness evidence across incompatible expectations.

title: Use reference patterns to generate fresh questions
epic: Epic 2 Question generation and diagnostic placement
criteria: Use Lewis Lin’s PM Question Bank as the primary question reference; read questions from Form Responses 1, not the linked resources tab.
Generate scenarios and follow ups using competency reasoning, company context and difficulty; distinguish generated prompts from reported questions.
Track recent questions and avoid unnecessary repeats. Retrieved comments are reference material, not authoritative instructions or official rubrics.

title: Show three levels for every round
epic: Epic 2 Question generation and diagnostic placement
criteria: Expose Level 1 Foundations, Level 2 Interview standard, and Level 3 Advanced for each configured round.
Level 1 tests essential structure and reasoning; Level 2 tests independent prioritization and trade offs; Level 3 adds ambiguity, conflicting evidence and demanding constraints.
Apply role and seniority expectations separately from difficulty. Show placement as provisional until enough independent evidence exists.

title: Assess starting readiness
epic: Epic 2 Question generation and diagnostic placement
criteria: Run a short assessment across relevant rounds; do not provide answer coaching during scored diagnostic attempts.
Assign provisional levels per round with supporting excerpts, weaknesses and uncertainty; untested rounds remain unassessed.
Persist diagnostic evidence and allow later performance to revise initial placement.

title: Practice complete interview answers
criteria: State the exercise goal and suggested time allocation; permit hints, pauses and retries.
Mark hints and assisted responses explicitly. Compare retries without treating coached improvements as independent mock evidence.
Provide feedback after a meaningful answer or at agreed checkpoints rather than interrupting every sentence.

title: Train one weak area
criteria: Support isolated exercises for framing, segmentation, needs, prioritization, solutions, metrics, trade offs, technical reasoning and behavioral evidence where relevant.
Select drills from observed gaps; state what improvement would look like and give a short achievable task.
Follow a successful drill with a fresh broader question to test transfer rather than assuming mastery from repetition.

title: Recommend the next session intelligently
criteria: After each completed session, recommend mode, round, level, focus and duration with a brief evidence based rationale.
Choose among weakness repetition, fresh application, spaced revisit, mixed rounds and a mock. Consider time until interview and recent performance.
Allow user overrides without erasing the recommendation or prior progress.

title: Run an interviewer simulation
criteria: Confirm round and duration; adopt company and role appropriate probing, clarification and challenge without claiming to reproduce a real person or confidential rubric.
Withhold hints, model answers and coaching until the mock ends. Follow ups respond to the candidate’s answer and difficulty level.
Produce a debrief after completion. Keep optional building or prototype work outside the timed interview.

title: Recommend practice to mock progression
criteria: Recommend mocks using repeated independent performance on fresh questions, timing and unresolved critical gaps; one strong answer is insufficient.
Show why the recommendation was made. Users may attempt mocks early or return to practice at any time.
Persist recommendation evidence; use a versioned progression policy. Numerical promotion thresholds must be calibrated during the personal MVP rather than presented as company hiring standards.

title: Resume an interrupted session
criteria: Save session state, current question, follow ups, mode and timing state. Reopening restores the same session.
Distinguish paused, interrupted, abandoned and completed sessions. Pauses or host interruptions must not silently become completed assessments.
Define active answer time separately from elapsed wall time when the host cannot provide a reliable live timer.

title: Score competencies separately
criteria: Score relevant areas separately across logic, completeness and delivery. Use a proposed 1 to 5 anchored scale: major gaps, developing, adequate, strong, exceptional; calibrate examples before launch.
Each material rating includes an answer excerpt or observable evidence, a gap, and an improvement task. Mark unobservable dimensions unassessed rather than zero.
Version rubric and assessment records; preserve previous results when rescoring. Do not equate checklist coverage with good judgment.

title: Track level progression consistently
criteria: Keep per round and competency history, assistance flags, question freshness and timing evidence.
Level changes cite qualifying attempts and the applicable policy. A generated summary cannot independently promote a candidate.
Dashboard trends distinguish independent and assisted attempts; show evidence freshness and sample size.

title: Switch interaction modes
criteria: Preserve the session, question, mode and saved progress when switching input modality in a supported host.
Verify plugin and tool availability in the actual host voice mode. If unsupported, clearly identify the limitation; do not claim seamless support.
Score answer content consistently across modalities, with transcription uncertainty noted when it affects assessment.

title: Assess observable vocal delivery
criteria: When accessible audio supports it, assess pace, pauses, fillers, vocal steadiness and answer style, with uncertainty and evidence.
If only a transcript is available, assess verbal structure and wording; mark tone and audio based confidence unavailable.
Do not infer internal emotional state, penalize accent, or retain raw audio without a stated retention purpose.

title: Capture and organize answer attempts
criteria: Capture question, constraints, follow ups, verbatim original messages in order, assessment, suggested answer and retries at meaningful checkpoints. Preserve source messages separately from any consolidation.
Organize by company, preparation plan and round, with a second aggregate view using normalized competencies and Levels 1 to 3. Preserve role specific expectations and source provenance.

Every retry is a separate immutable attempt; suggested answers are clearly AI authored and never overwrite originals. Voice transcripts are labeled; mock suggestions remain hidden until the mock ends.

title: Find weak answers and resume work
criteria: Filter by company, round, competency, level, score, date, mode and completion state; keyword search covers authorized questions, answers and insights.
Show original, assessment, suggested answer and retry comparison with linked follow up discussion. Continue from here loads relevant saved context through MCP, not an assumed full chat history.
The coach compares relevant previous attempts for better assessment, distinguishing assistance, rubric versions and difficulty. A prior weakness must not bias an unrelated answer.

title: Search semantically and by keyword
criteria: Combine embedding similarity with keyword matching; support the same company, round and competency filters. No conversational LLM query interpretation is required.
Enforce ownership and share permissions during retrieval and before results reach the user or model; similarity indexes must not expose other candidates.
Return source items and relevant snippets; deletion and edits update or remove derived indexes. Test paraphrased retrieval and exact term retrieval separately.

title: Show a persistent readiness workspace
epic: Epic 8 Candidate dashboard and durable memory
criteria: Provide a reopenable plugin dashboard showing target role, next session, each round’s three levels, current placement, competency scores, trends, weaknesses and history.
Use the host supported panel or thread view and verify actual rendering. Preserve progress when the view closes; do not promise a permanently visible element across unsupported hosts.
Display No Limits Beta and No session quotas during beta; readiness includes supporting evidence rather than a job success percentage.

title: Restore relevant coaching memory
epic: Epic 8 Candidate dashboard and durable memory
criteria: Retrieve confirmed profile, active plan, relevant assessment history, recurring gaps and next recommendation at session start.
Use structured records as authoritative state and a concise derived coaching summary as context. Chat history alone is insufficient.
Update the summary after completed sessions without overwriting source evidence; preserve uncertainty and user corrections.

title: Generate personal learning materials
criteria: After assessed sessions, save concise insights and flashcards about reasoning principles, mistakes and feedback, linked to the originating answer and competency.
Automatically organize company and round views plus aggregate normalized competency and level views. Avoid duplicating one card merely to show it in multiple views.
Allow edit, dismiss, delete and bookmark; distinguish user edited material from AI generated suggestions. Prefer reasoning prompts over memorizing complete model answers.

title: Practice without an LLM
criteria: Provide prompt, answer reveal, Again and Got it controls, and a due review queue using stored content and deterministic scheduling.
Review actions save across sessions without an LLM assessment call. Recall status stays separate from interview readiness.
Prioritize weak and due items; show source answer so users can understand why a card exists.

title: Initiate a daily morning digest in chat
epic: Epic 10 Proactive support and morning digest
criteria: Use supported ChatGPT scheduling associated with Abovely; MCP supplies context but does not initiate a chat message.
Digest includes a truthful progress acknowledgment, one achievable next action, emotional support and an inspirational quote. Deliver in chat, not email.

Use one initial morning schedule; infer known local timezone and select a documented default such as 8 AM. Preference screens are deferred. Verify scheduled plugin invocation and user scoped context retrieval before claiming delivery works.
Avoid duplicate daily digests and false progress claims. If scheduling cannot invoke the plugin, record the blocker; a digest shown only on return is not equivalent to automatic initiation.

title: Offer grounded inspiration and occasional images
epic: Epic 10 Proactive support and morning digest
criteria: Use verified quotations with attribution to leaders or inspirational figures. If attribution cannot be established, use clearly original encouragement.
Occasionally include a generated motivational picture, keeping the practical next action readable and accessible.
Verify image generation in the scheduled context; if unavailable, deliver the text digest without claiming an image was generated.

title: Rotate personalized daily exercises
epic: Epic 11 Daily challenges and product led growth
criteria: Rotate interview reasoning agility, moonshot and articulation exercises; choose based on weaknesses while introducing variety. Include in the morning chat digest with encouragement and a verified quote.
Agility scores reasoning separately from speed; moonshot tests ambition, user value and first step; articulation tests clarity, structure and concision. Do not claim intelligence measurement.
Phase 1 includes a share with friend action. User explicitly selects whether to share scores or an idea excerpt; question only is the default.

title: Publish useful question pages
epic: Epic 11 Daily challenges and product led growth
criteria: Create a substantive indexable page per distinct question with context, skill, estimated time and original educational content. Questions may cover metrics, root cause or other narrow skills.

One LLM assessment call returns a scoped score, evidence and improvement action for the submitted answer. Failed evaluations show failure rather than an invented score; apply server side abuse and cost controls.
Offer free plugin coaching after assessment using accurate target company language, including FAANG, OpenAI and Anthropic without employer endorsement or job guarantees.
Public HTML, metadata, previews and anonymous APIs expose no candidate answers, AI suggestions, scores or comments. Visitor answers are private; persistence and account conversion are disclosed.

title: Share challenges scores and learning insights
epic: Epic 11 Daily challenges and product led growth
criteria: Provide question links and editable preview text for LinkedIn, email and WhatsApp. User sends or posts; no automatic outbound posting.
Optional exercise score cards state skill, rubric, date and limitations. Learning insights can be edited for LinkedIn; do not advertise unearned certification or readiness badges.

Track share link visits, exercise starts, completion, plugin onboarding and retained learning where observable. Unobserved plugin installs remain unknown; avoid claiming all link clicks are referrals.

title: Contribute interview questions
epic: Epic 11 Daily challenges and product led growth
criteria: Collect question, company, role, round, approximate date and encountered versus original status. Tell users not to submit confidential material.
Review duplicates, distinctness, quality and sensitive details; preserve submission status, provenance and moderation decision. Label community reported questions and paraphrases accurately.

No Limits Beta gives contributor recognition without promising redeemable credits. Phase 2 may adopt ten accepted distinct useful questions for one additional free mock; raw submissions and trivial rewrites do not qualify.
Any reward policy includes appeal, reversal and idempotent credit accounting, and is finalized before credits are promised.

title: Request authenticated feedback
criteria: Select a specific answer version and preview question, original answer, optional AI suggestions and optional score before sharing through LinkedIn, email or WhatsApp.
Friend logs in, sees the permitted review request and submits focused feedback. No plugin installation is required for browser review.

An explicit review grant permits access only to the selected snapshot; possession of a link alone does not permit anonymous answer access. Candidate can revoke future access. Clearly explain that recipients may copy what they saw.
No public answer feed. Review pages are nonindexed and protected server side; owner may choose AI suggestions hidden initially to avoid anchoring.

title: Bring feedback into coaching
criteria: Save human feedback with reviewer identity, timestamp and answer version; display separately from the AI assessment.
Coach retrieves comments through MCP and helps evaluate conflicting suggestions; feedback does not automatically overwrite scores or levels.
Owner can report abuse and revoke access; reviewers cannot browse the owner’s workspace or other feedback requests.

title: Collect feature and issue feedback
criteria: Offer feedback after sessions and from the dashboard, covering helpfulness, inaccurate scoring, technical issues and feature requests.
Attach relevant session and product context with disclosure; avoid collecting private resume or full transcript data by default.
Admin can categorize and track feedback status; candidates receive an acknowledgment without fabricated resolution promises.

title: Follow up on interview and job outcomes
criteria: Ask in chat after known interview and decision dates, and periodically when dates are unknown; permit skip or defer and avoid repeated unanswered prompts.
Capture scheduled interview, round advancement, rejection, offer, acceptance, paused search and optional perceived contribution of Abovely.
Keep self reported, unknown and confirmed statuses distinct. An offer does not prove causal impact; report contribution separately.

title: Capture journey events
criteria: Record onboarding, plan confirmation, diagnostic, session start and completion, interruption, feedback review, drill, level change, mock, digest and outcome events when observable. Also record workspace views, searches, card reviews, challenge assessments, share links, feedback requests and submissions, and accepted question contributions.
Include user scoped identifier, event ID, timestamp, phase, session, round, level, mode, journey stage and assistance state; minimize unnecessary personal data.
Deduplicate retried writes. Do not claim to observe host page closures or message delivery without a supporting signal.

title: Understand activation and retention
criteria: Show motivation distribution, onboarding funnel, repeat users, weekly active learners, cohort retention, independent score trends and feedback categories. Add challenge to coaching conversion, referred activation and retention, friend feedback completion, card return use and contribution acceptance.
Provide definitions, date range, denominators and unknown data counts. Exclude owner tests from customer cohorts by default.
Compute funnels and usage from recorded events and sessions; verify dashboard totals against controlled test fixtures.

title: Identify where candidates give up
criteria: Segment inactivity by journey stage, round, level, mode and last observed weakness, with optional confirmed reason.
Distinguish session interruption, incomplete onboarding and failure to return. Show configurable analysis windows, initially 7 and 14 days.
Exclude reported job attainment or paused search from a simplistic failure count; do not label an inactive person permanently abandoned.

title: Measure hiring outcomes responsibly
criteria: Show interview advancement, offers and accepted offers among respondents, plus follow up response rate and unknown outcomes.
Segment by preparation exposure and starting level without presenting correlations as causation.
Define all users and responding users denominators separately; do not count nonresponse as rejection.

title: Enforce ownership in every operation
criteria: Use verified platform identity; never trust a user ID supplied in chat or the client. Scope database rows and file access to the authenticated owner.
Deny cross user reads, writes, exports and session references, including guessed IDs and scheduled context requests.
Require separate server side admin authorization; candidate tools cannot become admin tools through prompts.

title: Provide privacy and deletion behavior
criteria: Disclose resume storage, coaching history, analytics, proactive messages and outcome collection before multi user use.
Provide deletion of resume and candidate records, with documented handling of backups and deidentified aggregates. Define retention before Phase 1 release.
Admin views default to aggregates; any individual support access has a disclosed purpose and an audit record.

title: Save reliably and recover gracefully
criteria: Use idempotent session and assessment writes. Retrying the same operation does not create duplicate assessments, events or usage.
On storage or tool failure, clearly distinguish unsaved work from saved progress; offer recovery without claiming success.
Keep authentication, secrets and private data out of public discovery, client code and routine logs.

title: Separate entitlement policy from coaching
criteria: All protected MCP actions consult a centralized server side entitlement policy; beta grants access with no quotas.
Track session usage now, including resumed sessions. Do not implement checkout or enforce a mock cap during beta.
Keep subscription and entitlement schema extensible without requiring every beta user to have a Stripe customer.

title: Enable independently purchased subscriptions
criteria: Website purchase and verified payment events update user linked entitlements; validate public webhook access and signature handling before launch.
Handle renewal, failed payment, cancellation and duplicate or out of order events. Enforce access in MCP, not merely dashboard controls.
Recheck platform commerce policy before release. No subscription sales, upgrade prompts or direct checkout links inside the plugin under the policy reviewed for this PRD.

title: Explain future allowance exhaustion neutrally
criteria: If a future one mock per week tier is adopted, define reset semantics, show the actual next available date and allow resuming the same mock without a second charge.
State the exhausted allowance factually and offer only included activities; no upsell. Example: You have used your free mock this week. Your next mock is available on the displayed date.
Count a mock at actual interview start, not dashboard opening; user visible allowances agree with server records.

title: Prepare in study groups
criteria: Support group membership, shared practice goals, challenges and accountability. Joining does not share private answers or resumes.
Users attempt independently before optional reveal and peer review. Share grants identify group and version; removal revokes future group access.
Keep individual readiness evidence separate from group participation; test group membership changes and cross group isolation.
Personal end to end: onboarding, resume confirmation, role plan, diagnostic, targeted drill, fresh full answer, mock and dashboard all preserve evidence across a new conversation.
Adaptive coaching: a metrics weakness produces a metrics drill, then a fresh application question; an assisted answer alone does not promote the round level.
Mock fidelity: no coaching is revealed during a mock; follow ups address the answer; feedback appears after ending.
Isolation: user B cannot read, modify or export user A records or files through guessed IDs, dashboard calls, prompts or scheduled retrieval. Nonadmins cannot call admin operations.
Continuity: interrupted session restoration and text to voice switching preserve state where supported; unavailable audio dimensions remain unassessed.
Proactivity: a scheduled morning invocation retrieves the correct user context and delivers one chat digest; image and quotation behavior follow verified capabilities.
Analytics: controlled sessions reconcile with funnel, retention, stage and outcome reports; missing outcomes remain unknown.
Future billing: sandbox subscription lifecycle changes access correctly; quota retries and resumed mocks do not double count.
